intro: Builds an Obsidian-ready vault on one market: entity cards, a market map, an event ledger, and a review of borderline entries.

inputs.name: MARKET_TOPIC
inputs.label: Market
inputs.help: Three to six words. This names the vault and anchors every search.

inputs.name: SCOPE_IN
inputs.label: In scope
inputs.help: One sentence: what belongs in this market.

inputs.name: SCOPE_OUT
inputs.label: Out of scope
inputs.help: One sentence: the adjacent market that does not belong.

inputs.name: DOMAIN_ENTITY
inputs.label: Main entity type
inputs.help: For example Regulation, Standard, Trial. Leave empty for companies only.

inputs.name: SEED_SOURCE
inputs.label: Seed sources
inputs.placeholder: A URL, a file path, or a comma-separated list of names

inputs.name: OUTPUT_FOLDER
inputs.label: Vault folder
inputs.help: A folder Obsidian can open as a vault.

inputs.name: COVERAGE_TARGET
inputs.label: Field coverage to exit
inputs.help: Percent of cards that must carry each tracked field.

outro.title: Market vault is ready
outro.summary: The vault on **{{MARKET_TOPIC}}** is in `{{OUTPUT_FOLDER}}`. Open the folder in Obsidian, or browse it in the Document Graph.
nextSteps: Keep or reject the cards in `Resources/Relevance Review.md`.
